meta.audience: designers and the people who review their work
meta.title: FORM / 01
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css, src/styles in the app repository), its sample board (domain/sample.ts: the SVG mockups, three reviewers, their pins and threads) and its captured panels. A precise inspection desk: near-black #0B0B0C and metal greys #D9DADC to #8E9096, vivid colour only on the reviewers' pins (#FF5A1F, #3D7BFF, #C6FF3D).

source.notes: a light feedback board for designers: upload work, drop numbered pins and regions on it, keep versions and compare them, export a report
the app's own sample mockups (SVG, written by its domain/sample.ts): the Sonar Notes landing v1 and v2, the dashboard, the mobile onboarding

the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json: the comment cards on v1 and v2, a thread, the version bar, the panel's stats; and the mockups rendered by gen-src/render_mockups.json
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: ink #0B0B0C / #101012 / #1C1C20, text #EDEDEF / #B6B7BC / #8C8D93, the metal plate (118deg #E7E8EA to #8E9096 with a white sheen), and the three reviewers' pin colours, orange #FF5A1F, blue #3D7BFF and lime #C6FF3D, the only vivid colour on screen.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 860 with -0.058em for FORM / 01 (its slash at 300 in half-black), 800 for headlines; mono capitals for the app's labels (DESIGN REVIEW BOARD — PIN · THREAD · VERSION, VER, OPEN, RESOLVED) and the dimension lines.
rationale.motion: An inspection desk: rulers and crop marks, dimension lines that measure the artboard, pins that drop and settle on their anchor corner, a region drawn by dragging, a comparison divider that sweeps between versions.
rationale.sound: Cinematic-lite in E minor at 112 BPM (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s): piano and soft strings over toms, measured and calm, with a soft tick for every pin.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the app's metal hero with its mockups, dimension lines and pins under the name; three reviewers' pins and region landing on the real landing page with their real comment cards; v1 and v2 compared under a sweeping divider; the end card. The 30 s cut adds a thread being answered and resolved.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
